title: Canon secures JAXA funding for SPAD satellite targeting high-resolution day-night Earth observation
html: Canon has announced that its project to develop an ultra-high-sensitivity satellite equipped with single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) imaging technology has been selected for support under the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency's (JAXA) Space Strategy Fund.
